product_metadata.title: VEVA HEPA Filter Replacement 2 Pack - Premium Air Purifier Filters, Compatible w/ Dyson Pure Cool Link Models TP01, TP02, TP03 & BP01
features: Premium: Our high-caliber HEPA air purifier filter replacements are essential for keeping the air in your living space healthy & clean
Purify: Perfect for households with pets, cooking & smokers, our air filter replacements work to trap odors and purify your home.
Quality: This HEPA air filter replacement 2-pack captures unwanted particles (as small as 0.3 microns in size) traveling through your home
Value: Our HEPA replacement filter pack includes 2 premium HEPA filters that are easy to replace. You'll never run out!

Precision Fit: Our HEPA filter replacements are compatible with Dyson Air Purifier Pure Cool Link Tower TP01, TP02, TP03, BP01, Part #305158-01, 305159-01, 308400-01, 308401-01, Replacement Part # 968126-03.
